items.html: However, the first 72 of them all is more explicit, and therefore that 72 is counted alone, and it is in gematria Hesed, and therefore its place is in Hesed. And the three other 72s become 216, which is in gematria Gevura. Behold, 72-216, as above. And with this you will understand how the nursing, too, is in the secret of pregnancy — namely, the letters 72 and 216 mentioned.
